faq.a: Hassani is associated with the Arabic form حَسَنِي, whose core sense is hassani; good, handsome (swahili form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Hassani?
faq.a: Hassani is associated with Arabic. Hassani is the Swahili form of Arabic حَسَن (Ḥasan), meaning 'good, handsome'.
Yes — the underlying form حَسَنِي is Arabic.
Hassani can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hassani should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥasan is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Hassani mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hassani is rendered حسنی and carries the sense حسنی، نیکو.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hassani?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hassani, hassani. Script forms are حسني, حسنی, حَسَنِي, हसनी.

faq.q: Is Hassani a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
